problem: createOrder obtained a genuine WeChat JSAPI prepay, then crashed: `db.collection('payment_logs').add` threw -502005 because the `payment_logs` collection did not exist in env fanshex-d2g0adgv7dfbc9bdc. The audit-log write sat as a FATAL gate between the authenticated prepay and the order→pending_payment transition, so the order stayed `created` and 10009 was returned to the client. Also: verifyPayment referenced CODES.ORDER_CLOSED/ORDER_REFUNDED/ORDER_EXPIRED/FORBIDDEN which were undefined in the per-function errorCodes copies (degraded to UNKNOWN 10001); createOrder referenced CODES.DUPLICATE/CODES.PRICE_ERROR, equally undefined.

changes.COLLECTION_CREATED: Created `payment_logs` in fanshex-d2g0adgv7dfbc9bdc (verified absent beforehand; writability verified with a temporary marker doc that was deleted; count back to 0). No existing collection/document mutated.
changes.SAFE_LOG_HELPER: New shared module cloudfunctions/common/paymentLog.js :: safeWritePaymentLog(db, entry) — whitelisted safe fields only; catches ALL errors, logs safe metadata, returns {logged:false}; NEVER throws into the payment flow. Mirrored byte-identical to createOrder/lib + verifyPayment/lib.
changes.CREATEORDER_ORDERING: Reordered so the business-critical sequence is: (1) authenticated WeChat prepay success → (2) persist order → pending_payment + paymentParams → (3) return; the payment_logs write is now best-effort (safeWritePaymentLog) AFTER the order state transition. On prepay failure: order→failed BEFORE the (best-effort) log write. A log failure can no longer produce PAYMENT_ERROR or block paymentParams.
changes.VERIFYPAYMENT_LOGGING: The non-authoritative audit write (step 6) now uses safeWritePaymentLog (was a fatal raw add). Authoritative finalizePaidOrder path unchanged.
changes.PAYCALLBACK_LOGGING: Audited: payCallback writes only to evolution_logs via _log(), already try/catch non-fatal; it has no payment_logs write. No change needed (not redeployed).
changes.FINALIZER_LOGGING: Audited: paymentFinalizer._audit() is already try/catch non-fatal; authoritative state writes (orders paid transition, payments row, entitlement_grants marker) are NOT weakened. No change (Stage3 semantics preserved).
changes.ERROR_CODES_SYNCED: Synced createOrder/lib/errorCodes.js + verifyPayment/lib/errorCodes.js to the canonical superset common/errorCodes.js (byte-identical, sha1 5d3b0d8b4a09). Adds ORDER_EXPIRED:10016, ORDER_CLOSED:10017, ORDER_REFUNDED:10018, FORBIDDEN:10019, DUPLICATE:10020, PRICE_ERROR:10015, RATE_LIMITED:10021. NO existing public code renumbered.
changes.TESTS: tests/rc8.9/payment-log-resilience.test.js (A–H, 35 assertions) using the REAL handlers with stubbed wx-server-sdk + network: A log OK; B log collection missing; C log throws; D prepay fails + log missing not converted to success; E verify authoritative failure → no paid; F callback invalid signature → no paid; G finalizer _audit failure → invariants unchanged; H error-code regression (no UNKNOWN degrade).

rollbackPlan: git revert <this-commit>; redeploy createOrder/verifyPayment at prior commit. Collection creation is additive (harmless if left).
